layout_patterns_library.name: Hero Full Width

responsive_behavior.mobile: Content stacked centrally or aligned to start, full-width media. CTAs stacked.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Content aligned to start or centered, full-width or background media. CTAs inline or stacked.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Content aligned to start or centered, full-width or background media. CTAs inline.

rtl_notes: Text and CTA alignment uses logical 'start' direction. If media is content-bearing, its position should be logical 'start' or 'end' if split.

layout_patterns_library.name: Content Stack Block

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, content stacked vertically.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, content stacked vertically.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, content stacked vertically, often with a max-width for readability.

rtl_notes: Text alignment uses logical 'start' direction.

layout_patterns_library.name: Grid Features (1-2-3 Columns)

responsive_behavior.mobile: 1 column grid for cards/items.
responsive_behavior.tablet: 2 column grid for cards/items.
responsive_behavior.desktop: 3 column grid for cards/items. (Can be 2 or 3 based on content density).

rtl_notes: Grid items flow naturally in the document direction. Content within each grid item aligns to logical 'start'.

layout_patterns_library.name: Process Steps Vertical

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, steps stacked vertically.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, steps stacked vertically.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, steps stacked vertically, often with a max-width for readability.

rtl_notes: Numbers/icons placed at the logical 'start' of each step. Text aligns to logical 'start'.

layout_patterns_library.name: Primary CTA Banner

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full-width banner, stacked text and CTA.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full-width banner, text and CTA centered or aligned to start.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full-width banner, text and CTA centered or aligned to start.

rtl_notes: Text and CTA alignment uses logical 'start' direction.

layout_patterns_library.name: FAQ Accordion List

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, stacked accordion items.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, stacked accordion items, often with a max-width for readability.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, stacked accordion items, often with a max-width for readability.

rtl_notes: Text alignment uses logical 'start' direction. Accordion icons should be direction-agnostic or mirrored.

layout_patterns_library.name: Hero - Split Text & Media

responsive_behavior.mobile: Vertical stack: Media (optional) on top, then text, then CTAs. Full width.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Two columns: Text on one side, media on the other. Larger text/CTAs. 50/50 or 60/40 split.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Two columns: Text on one side, media on the other. Optimized for readability. 50/50 or 60/40 split.

rtl_notes: Content order (text/media) should respect logical flow (e.g., text block 'start' position adapts to direction). Internal text aligns to start.

layout_patterns_library.name: Content - Stacked Blocks

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, content blocks stack vertically. Full width.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, wider content blocks. Centered or left-aligned.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, constrained max-width for readability. Centered or left-aligned.

rtl_notes: Text alignment for content_block should be 'start' (left in LTR, right in RTL).

layout_patterns_library.name: Grid - Content Cards

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column grid, cards stack vertically.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Two-column grid.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Two or three-column grid, depending on content density.

rtl_notes: Grid order flows correctly. Text within cards aligns to 'start'.

layout_patterns_library.name: Process - Vertical Steps

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, steps stack vertically, clear separator/numbering.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, steps stack vertically, possibly wider content.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, steps stack vertically, constrained max-width.

rtl_notes: Numbering/icons should precede content directionally (e.g., number-text in LTR, number-text in RTL, with text being RTL).

layout_patterns_library.name: FAQ - Accordion Style

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column, full width accordion items.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column, wider accordion items.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Single column, constrained max-width for readability.

rtl_notes: Accordion expand/collapse icon position adapts to 'end' of item. Text aligns 'start'.

layout_patterns_library.name: Footer - Call To Action Banner
use_cases: Final conversion point on a page

responsive_behavior.mobile: Vertical stack: headline, then CTA. Centered.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Centrally aligned text and CTA, potentially on a wider banner.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Centrally aligned text and CTA, within a clear, distinct banner area.

rtl_notes: Text and CTA are horizontally centered, so direction agnostic.

layout_patterns_library.name: Hero Banner Layout

responsive_behavior.mobile: Stack content and CTA below media. Text and CTA span full width.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Content and CTA aligned with media (side-by-side or overlay). Text and CTA span ~60-80% width.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Content and CTA aligned with media. Text and CTA span ~50-60% width for optimal readability.

rtl_notes: Text alignment within content_block should use logical properties (text-align-start).
If media and text are side-by-side, visual order should mirror in RTL.

layout_patterns_library.name: Stacked Content Block

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width content stack.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full width content stack, possibly with wider max-width for readability.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full width content stack, with max-width for optimal readability (e.g., 60-70% of container width) centered or aligned start.

rtl_notes: Text alignment within content_block should use logical properties (text-align-start).
No specific visual mirroring needed beyond text direction.

layout_patterns_library.name: Feature/Testimonial Grid Card
use_cases: Gallery of testimonials or client logos

responsive_behavior.mobile: 1 column grid, full width cards.
responsive_behavior.tablet: 2 column grid.
responsive_behavior.desktop: 3 column grid.

rtl_notes: Grid flow should be consistent. Cards themselves should handle RTL text within their content_blocks. Logical spacing between cards.

layout_patterns_library.name: Split Section (Content & Media)

responsive_behavior.mobile: Content block stacks above media block, both full width.
responsive_behavior.tablet: 2-column grid (50/50 or 60/40 split), content on one side, media on other.
responsive_behavior.desktop: 2-column grid (50/50 or 60/40 split), content on one side, media on other.

rtl_notes: Visual order of content and media should mirror in RTL (e.g., if LTR is text-image, RTL is image-text).
Text alignment within content_block should use logical properties.

layout_patterns_library.name: Pricing Table Grid

responsive_behavior.mobile: 1 column grid, full width pricing cards.
responsive_behavior.tablet: 2 column grid.
responsive_behavior.desktop: 3 column grid.

rtl_notes: Grid flow should be consistent. Pricing cards themselves should handle RTL text within their content_blocks. Logical spacing between cards.

layout_patterns_library.name: Full Width CTA Banner
use_cases: Reinforcing primary CTA at page end

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width banner, stacked text and CTA.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full width banner, text and CTA centered horizontally.
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full width banner, text and CTA centered horizontally.

rtl_notes: Text alignment within content_block should use logical properties (text-align-center or text-align-start, depending on design). Direction-agnostic.

layout_patterns_library.name: Hero - Centered Content

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width, content stacked and centered
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full width, content stacked and centered
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full width, content stacked and centered

rtl_notes: Content is always horizontally centered, making it direction-agnostic.

layout_patterns_library.name: Split - Content and Media

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column stack: Media on top, Content below
responsive_behavior.tablet: Two columns: Content and Media side-by-side
responsive_behavior.desktop: Two columns: Content and Media side-by-side

rtl_notes: Content and Media column order should reverse automatically based on text direction (start/end alignment).

layout_patterns_library.name: Grid - Multiple Cards

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column stack of cards
responsive_behavior.tablet: Two-column grid
responsive_behavior.desktop: Three or more column grid

rtl_notes: Grid item order flows from logical start to end. Card content respects text direction.

layout_patterns_library.name: Stacked - Vertical Content Blocks

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width, blocks stacked
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full width, blocks stacked
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full width, blocks stacked (potentially narrower central column)

rtl_notes: Content within each block respects text direction. Overall stacking is vertical and direction-agnostic.

layout_patterns_library.name: Process - Linear Steps

responsive_behavior.mobile: Single column vertical list of steps
responsive_behavior.tablet: Single column vertical list of steps
responsive_behavior.desktop: Horizontal or vertical list depending on complexity, typically with icons/numbers guiding flow

rtl_notes: Step numbers/icons and text flow from logical start to end. Visual connectors between steps should adapt to direction.

layout_patterns_library.name: Call to Action - Full Width Banner

responsive_behavior.mobile: Full width, content and CTA stacked centered
responsive_behavior.tablet: Full width, content and CTA stacked centered
responsive_behavior.desktop: Full width, content and CTA horizontally aligned or stacked centered

rtl_notes: Content and CTA within the banner should be centered or respect start/end alignment.

responsive_rules.rule: All layouts are mobile-first, adapting gracefully to tablet and desktop breakpoints.
Content sections transition from single-column stacks on mobile to multi-column grids or wider single-column layouts on larger screens for optimal readability and utilization of space.
Interactive elements and CTAs maintain prominent sizing on mobile and scale appropriately for tablet/desktop to ensure tap/click target visibility.

rtl_rules.rule: All layouts inherently support RTL by using logical properties (e.g., 'start'/'end' for alignment, 'inline-start'/'inline-end' for spacing) instead of fixed 'left'/'right'.
Visual elements (icons, images) and their associated text will adapt directionally without requiring separate layouts.
Grid ordering will follow document flow, which naturally reverses in RTL contexts.
Text alignment within content blocks will be 'start' to ensure natural reading direction.

for_copy_agent: Ensure all copy is concise, benefit-led, and aligns with the brand strategy's tone (Confident, Supportive, Professional, Outcome-focused, Direct). Pay special attention to multilingual content for EN/HE/AR, ensuring cultural appropriateness and clear calls to action for WhatsApp. Headlines should be impactful and subheadings should provide clear context.
for_codegen_agent: Implement layouts using a component-based approach. Utilize CSS Grid for section-level layouts and Flexbox for internal component alignment. Prioritize semantic HTML. Ensure all spacing tokens (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) from brand identity are mapped to responsive CSS variables. Implement logical properties for RTL support (e.g., margin-inline-start instead of margin-left). All CTAs should have clear click areas and accessibility considerations. Media placeholders should be implemented responsively.

notes: Hero section with a strong headline, visual, and prominent CTAs.
A simple text block to introduce the success stories.

responsive_rules.rule: For 'featured_case_studies', individual case study elements (text, image, quote) should stack vertically within their container on mobile and tablet for readability. On desktop, consider a 2-column split (e.g., text details on left, image/quote on right) for each case study.
All grid sections will collapse to a single column on mobile, with items spanning full width.

rtl_rules.rule: All text content blocks will respect text direction (start/end) and align content logically (e.g., text-align: start).
